Accept (`true`) or decline (`false`) an invite as the logged-in user.

CatalogResponse.description: Permission groups: each key is a group, its value the group's actions (permission name = `group.action`). `__classification` sorts the names by who enforces them.

CreateCurrencyRequest.description: New currency. `asset_type` is an ISO 4217 code.

permissions.description: Permission names to grant; unknown names are ignored.

workspace_name.description: Lowercase letters, numbers and single dashes.

oneOf.description: Team the invitee joins on accepting.

invited_by.description: Email of whoever sent the invite.

InviteStatusResponse.description: What an invite link points to, for the accept or sign-up screen.

color.description: Display color; not stored yet, always null.

teams.description: The member's teams in this workspace.

MemberTeamResource.description: A team as listed on a member row.

from.description: 1-based index of first row on this page; null when the page is empty.

PersonFields.description: The new person's name, login email and password.

password.description: At least 8 characters with upper and lower case, a number and a symbol.

RegisterRequest.description:
POST /v1/register: new account through an invite.
Create an account through an invite link.

SendInviteRequest.description:
POST /v1/workspace/{workspace}/invites. `team_id`: team the invitee joins on accept.
Invite someone by email, optionally straight into a team.

team_id.description: Team the invitee joins on accepting.

TeamCreated.description: Create response: the new team's id.

TeamResource.description: A team: a named group of members sharing a set of permissions.

relationships.description: `[]` when members were not loaded, otherwise `{"users": [...]}`

TokenResponse.description: A login session: send `access_token` as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

UpdateCurrencyRequest.description: Changes to a currency. Leave a field out to keep it; send null to clear it.

UpdateTeamRequest.description: Changes to a team. Leave a field out to keep it; send null `meta` to clear it.

UserDetail.description: A member as seen from one workspace: only that workspace's permissions and teams.

UserEmailResource.description: A user shown inside another record (team member, inviter, ...).

color.description: Display color; not stored yet, always null.

UserIdsRequest.description: Users to add to or remove from the team.

UserResource.description: A user with their permissions, teams and pending invites.

color.description: Display color; not stored yet, always null.

ValidationErrorBody.description: Validation failed. `errors` maps each field to its messages.

WorkspaceAccount.description: Bank details. Unset values are null.

account_number.description: IBAN; spaces and case are normalized.

WorkspaceAddress.description: Company address. Unset values are null.

house_number.description: Numeric, sent as a string or a number; returned as sent.
Numeric; a string or a number.

WorkspaceProfile.description: Company profile. Every key is always present; unset values are null.

oneOf.description: Bank details; left out where any member can read the profile.

WorkspaceProfilePatch.description: Company profile changes. Leave a key out to keep it; send null (or a blank string) to clear it. A sent `address` or `account` replaces the stored one.

WorkspaceRecordResource.description: The workspace record with its full company profile.

WorkspaceResource.description: A workspace the user belongs to.

Company profile; left out until one is saved. Bank details (`account`) are never
included here.
